speaker: charlie
text: Thanks Sam, and now for something that's absolutely mind-blowing - meet Michael Girgis, a four-year-old piano prodigy from the D.C. area who's about to make history as one of the youngest musicians ever to perform at Carnegie Hall.

speaker: alice
text: Alex, this little fella has had less than a year of piano lessons but he's already won multiple international competitions! His parents say he reads musical notes better than letters and his love for music is just constant. Can you imagine being four years old and playing at Carnegie Hall?

speaker: charlie
text: It just goes to show that talent and passion can emerge at any age. This young champion is proving that when you follow your dreams and put in the work, incredible things can happen. What an inspiration for kids and adults alike!
